item.title: Preseterizer 0.1.1
item.description:
• Seeds with no free macro knob now also make variations in Mutations packs (without the weird macro), as they already did in ladders.
  • The setting is now called "Only seeds with room for the weird macro" (Settings › New packs start with › Room); on, those seeds make only hybrids and no ladder.
  • A pack's page counts the presets without a weird macro.
